description: Project templates for RedBase (REDB), the entity database for .NET: a console app (dotnet new redb), a Razor Pages site (redb-razor), a Blazor site (redb-blazor), an integration worker (redb-worker), an LLM chat (redb-chat), a Blazor WebAssembly app with a redb.Route API (redb-app), a Blazor BFF with redb.Route controllers (redb-bff), an application on redb.Identity (redb-identity-app: a module beside Identity with token introspection in process, and an OpenID Connect web server) and Tsak modules with routes in XML markup next to the same routes in C# (redb-route, and redb-route-rest, -rabbitmq, -kafka, -sql, -sql-batch, -eip, -scatter-gather, -validator-xslt, -xmljson, -beans, -redb, -ldap, -s3, -email, -file, -cron, -amqp, -mqtt, -as2, -as4 for one scenario each). The database ones run as is on SQLite with Pro; the route-based ones also deploy as Tsak modules.
title: RedBase Project Templates
